notes.title: New Update & Speedrun mode !
notes.content:
New Update of the game, v1.5
-Added a SpeedRun mode with best time ranking per level and best run in one shot.
-Added 3 difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Difficult)
-Added CheckPoints in Easy Mode
-Better animation of the character Alice
-Slightly Improved jump physics

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10021114/82ffca8cdd77e4ca291c0b26115a63952b2dbe2a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gamepad controller bug fixed !
notes.content:
The initial version of the game had a bug if playing with an analog gamepad controller, I just made an update and this should now be fixed !
I hope you can all enjoy the game now :)
